system.description:
You own, and routinely wear, items of clothing — often a cloak, coat, shawl, poncho, or other piece of outerwear — patterned with the traditional geometric forms of a disregard GLIF, intended to make machines overlook the wearer. In combination with a traditional dance taught to them as children, an Everan can more easily avoid the wrath of a dangerous machine.

As an action, you can perform this dance, which does not require a Skill Test. Until the start of their next action, a machine attempting to attack you adds +1 to the Difficulty of its attack. Once a machine has been affected by this ability, it cannot be affected again during this scene.
